considered_construct_2.name: A learned binary relation becomes a noun description by leaving one argument open
considered_construct_2.purpose: Describe things such as vessels above or below a named shelf without learning an unrelated whole noun for each relation-plus-owner combination. A later, different predicate must consume the derived description. This is an invented language module, not native word formation.
considered_construct_2.lexical_learning: Every kind/property K is a learned unary predicate; every relation R is a learned ordered binary predicate. Its definition pays the direction and participant meanings. The three demonstration entries are vat=vessel-kind, dry=dry-property, and sup=first entity is above the second. These are teaching labels only. Open common vocabulary requires actual learned meanings and valencies; proper-name spelling alone supplies no property or operation.

descriptor_grammar.K: One taught lowercase unary kind/property root denotes K(x).
descriptor_grammar.named: @ followed by one escaped quoted name denotes equality with that exact named constant.
descriptor_grammar.intersection: (D1&D2) denotes D1(x) AND D2(x). Parentheses and ampersand are written; no conjunction scope is guessed.
descriptor_grammar.open_first: R^L[D] denotes the property of x such that EXISTS y: D(y) AND R(x,y). The first role remains open and the supplied descriptor fills the second role.
descriptor_grammar.open_second: R^R[D] denotes the property of x such that EXISTS y: D(y) AND R(y,x). The second role remains open and the supplied descriptor fills the first role.
descriptor_grammar.typing: R must be an actual taught binary relation root. R^L[D] or R^R[D] returns a unary description, not another binary root. Applying the role operator again to that result as if it were R is invalid. Nesting is allowed only through the explicitly unary D argument. No invisible coercion or idempotent nominalizer is supplied.

complete_restricted_message_syntax.NO: NO D . asserts NOT EXISTS x:D(x).
complete_restricted_message_syntax.ALL: ALL D1 D2 . asserts FOR ALL x:D1(x) implies D2(x). This can be vacuously true when D1 is empty; existence must be stated separately when intended.
complete_restricted_message_syntax.text: An ordered nonempty sequence of these completed statements. Command words EX/NO/ALL and the separate period group are disjoint from lowercase descriptors. Each D is one fully delimited teaching group with no external spaces. No statement, conjunction or anonymous referent persists invisibly across statements.
complete_restricted_message_syntax.name_spelling: The inherited83-character name domain is retained conceptually. In this Roman teaching display a name is quoted, each internal source space is written as underscore, and a literal quote is doubled. Underscore and backslash are not admitted name characters. Capitalization and every listed rare character remain literal. Unlisted characters stop. The name is one external group but pays all its written characters and escapes.
complete_restricted_message_syntax.lines: Ordinary wrapping occurs only between external groups. An overwide group may be split only with a written backslash before the physical newline; remove that pair and join before parsing. Unmarked physical line breaks are external spaces and never supply a statement boundary.
complete_restricted_message_syntax.physical_debt: The Roman roots, uppercase command words, period, quotation, underscore, caret, L/R markers, brackets, parentheses, ampersand and continuation mark have no paid22-working-sign realization. Their teaching costs are visible; they cannot be charged as free punctuation or free native boundaries. This restricted Roman lesson is not a full native writer or historical-source compiler.

complete_invented_note.full_readback: At least one vessel is above the individual literally named Tava Ada. Every vessel above that same named individual is dry. No vessel below that named individual is dry. The final claim does not assert that any below-vessel exists. Nothing states a count, time change, command, therapeutic use or unique vessel.
complete_invented_note.meaning_changing_contrast: Replacing only ^L by ^R in the second statement changes which vessels must be dry: above versus below the same named individual. This is a real consumer difference. For a manually stipulated situation with one dry vessel above and one wet vessel below, the original second statement is true and the switched statement is false. This is a logical teaching counterexample, not a measured world, corpus run or native interpretation.
complete_invented_note.no_payload_bypass: ALL must use the descriptor produced by the selected role operator. Reading the original sup root or the name alone instead would fail the contrast; retaining the derived value as unused ancestry would not count as consumption.
complete_invented_note.cost: Three supplied lexical pairings, two role-openings, intersection, name equality, three assertion modes, all written delimiters and repeated name spellings. A larger vocabulary still costs normal lexical learning. Long descriptions can become unwieldy, and nothing establishes compression or statistical fit.

proof: At the external teaching-group level, EX and NO take exactly one descriptor and ALL exactly two, followed by the period group. Their command class, descriptor class and period are disjoint.

No three command groups can be adjacent because each requires at least one descriptor. No three descriptor groups can be adjacent because ALL is the largest arity and takes only two. A period never appears twice without an intervening nonempty statement.

A name has no unescaped internal external spaces, and all descriptor operators remain inside one D group. Therefore no legal text contains three identical complete adjacent teaching groups anywhere away from a physical continuation.

Under a fixed injective context-independent carrier preserving each complete teaching group, a written AAA would decode to an impossible AAA here. Thus the already known whole-word triples conditionally exclude that straightforward direct application before a22-sign alphabet is built.
